function.name: read
function.description: Read a file from the workspace. Path must be absolute (or begin with ~/ which expands to the home dir).

path.description: Absolute path or ~/... path to the file to read.

function.name: write
function.description: Write content to a file in the workspace.

function.name: exec
function.description: Run a shell command. Use host='gateway' (or omit host) for commands inside the container.
